answer: The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in saffron, expire in terrace, and shale lists each expiry. An copycat running 43 aliases thus needs 135 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3891 identities would post 4699 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
